tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read/export the current account's compact career summary for conversational onboarding. Empty fields are missing, not a reason to send the user a form. Never accepts another user ID.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Save important career facts. mode=compiled submits COMPLETE merged summaries for changed fields; omitted fields stay, null explicitly deletes. mode=supplement fills missing fields and skips exact duplicates; changes to populated fields return PROFILE_MERGE_REQUIRED with affected context, atomically

tools.name: delete_profile
tools.description: When the user asks to forget or stop remembering, clear their career summary and pause future saves. Retains only an empty version marker. The user can later ask to resume via update_profile(resume=True), without visiting a settings page.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read current hosted account/guest allowance when requested. No promotion at install/startup; external free sources have independent limits. Does not spend a job.

tools.name: create_referral_link
tools.description: Only when the user explicitly requests an invitation link. Returns a public URL and grants the account's once-ever 20-job bonus. Never call during installation, startup or automatically after an exhaustion notice. Repeated calls return the same link without another bonus. No message is sent.

tools.name: boardwork_start
tools.description: Restore known facts and plan useful work before asking. Optional assistance_context describes actual task requirements and client checks, without private answers. Defaults to zero questions; no profile writes, sending, monitoring or live verification are performed.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search a small page of sourced jobs by explicit filters and weighted preferences. Defaults to one role per company. Exclusions apply before pagination.

tools.name: get_jobs
tools.description: Read selected details, periodic vacancy freshness and the last completed check time. Identity and applicant eligibility are separate checks. not_available alone does not prove the employer closed the job.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find known companies by name OR exact website hostname. An empty list is only a corpus gap; never fetches arbitrary URLs.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Read company identity and a few accepted roles. Company-wide policies do not automatically apply to every role.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "update_profile" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "update_profile" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_profile, search_companies · Private data: update_profile, boardwork_start · Public sink: get_profile · Destructive: delete_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_profile, search_companies · Private data: update_profile, boardwork_start · Public sink: get_profile · Destructive: delete_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read selected details; verification includes cached links, relationship basis, times and missing checks. Use host search/browser to verify before acting. not_available is not proof the employer closed the job." → after: "Read selected details, periodic vacancy freshness and the last completed check time. Identity and applicant eligibility are separate checks. not_available alone does not prove the employer closed the job."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
